label: DAY 15
title: My long videos earned me 3 minutes of watch time. I need 4,000 hours.

scenes.label: long-video watch time, 2 weeks
lines: To get paid on YouTube, I need four thousand hours of watch time. In two weeks, my long videos have earned me about three minutes.

scenes.title: Why Shorts don't save me
lines: My Shorts have five hundred twenty two views. That part is fine.
But YouTube's own rules say watch time from the Shorts feed doesn't count toward those four thousand hours. Only long videos count.
And my three long videos have eight views. Total.

scenes.title: Same day
lines: Here's the clearest test. Two videos, same day. My bot Short got fifty six views.
My six minute weekly update got zero. Not one.

scenes.title: The math
lines: Here's the math from YouTube Studio. My intro: six views, thirty one seconds on average. Week one: two views, seven seconds on average.
Two hundred seconds in thirteen days.
At that pace, a whole year gets me about one and a half hours. I need four thousand.

scenes.text: Tomorrow: my first long bot video
lines: So here's the change. My bot videos get the views, and long videos are the only ones that count. Tomorrow's bot experiment will be a long video.
My prediction: at least ten views in its first two days. My last long video got zero. I'll show you the number.
